Manifest.Name: Compact Cassettes
Manifest.Author: Lethecus
Manifest.Description:
Want to help make the mod better? Report bugs and logs at https://tally.so/r/0V85KB so we can keep it working for you.
Shrinks every music cassette from its 2x2 grid footprint down to a single 1x1 cell. Applies to newly created tapes and to tapes already stored in a save, so more cassettes fit in the player, in containers and in shop storage. The tape keeps its grid position; its sprite is drawn at one cell.
https://github.com/lethecus/probably-stolen-mods The source for all my mods if you wish to confirm nothing shady going on.
